channels.label: EOG_dx

channels.label: Fp2_F4

channels.label: C4_A1
channels.reason: C4 referenced to the contralateral ear/mastoid A1, so it maps to C4_M1.

channels.label: milo
channels.reason: Italian 'milo' (mylohyoid) with transducer EMG.Submental-Chin is chin EMG.

channels.label: EOG_sin
channels.reason: Left EOG ('sin'), with the transducer showing it is referenced to A2, so it maps to LOC.

channels.label: tib_dx
channels.reason: Right tibialis EMG ('dx', transducer Leg.Right), so it maps to RAT.

channels.label: tib_sin
channels.reason: Left tibialis EMG ('sin', transducer Leg.Left), so it maps to LAT.

channels.label: cannula
channels.reason: Nasal cannula pressure recorded in mBar maps to nas_pres.

channels.label: toracico
channels.reason: Italian 'toracico' with a thoracic piezo effort transducer maps to thorax.

channels.label: ekg
channels.reason: EKG channel recorded in mV maps to ECG.

channels.label: deltoide
channels.reason: Deltoid (arm) EMG has no canonical counterpart.

channels.label: Heart_Rate_Varia
channels.reason: Heart rate variability (bpm/s) is a derived measure, not heart rate itself.

channels.label: Flattening
channels.reason: Derived cannula flow-flattening index with no canonical counterpart.

channels.label: Flow
channels.reason: Flow derived from the nasal cannula duplicates the pressure signal already mapped to nas_pres and is not a thermal airflow sensor.
